entity1.id1.title: Codsiga magangelyo ee Austria

entity1.id1.entry1.title: Ma ka dalban karaa magangelyo dibadda?
entity1.id1.entry1.subtitle: Maya, codsiga magangalyada waxaa lagu soo gudbin karaa oo kaliya shaqsi ahaan iyo hadal ahaan gudaha dalka (ie. Austria).Sidaa darteed suurtogal maaha inaad Austraia magangelyo ka codsato dibadda!

entity1.id1.entry2.subtitle: Waxaad codsi magangalyo u gudbin kartaa maamul kasta oo booliis ama sarkaal ka tirsan booliiska.
entity1.id1.entry3.title: Goorma ayay magangelyadu dalbanaysaa?
entity1.id1.entry3.subtitle:
Shuruuda lagu codsanayo magangelyo waa cabsi sal leh oo laga cabsanayo cadaadis sababo gaar ah oo lagu baxsanayo:
• Taranka
•Diinta
•Qarannimo
Ka mid noqoshada koox bulsho oo gaar ah
•ama sababtoo ah waxay aaminsan yihiin siyaasad.

entity1.id3.subtitle: Maxaa la hubiyaa inta lagu jiro nidaamka magangalyada?
entity1.id3.entry1.title: Austria ayaa ka masuul ah
entity1.id3.entry1.subtitle: Habka gelitaanka ayaa caddaynaya in Austria ay mas'uul ka tahay waxa ku jira nidaamka magangalyada iyo haddii codsiga la aqbali karo.
entity1.id3.entry2.title: Haddii Austria aysan mas'uul ka ahayn:
entity1.id3.entry2.subtitle:
• Haddii magangelyo-doonku uu magangalyo ka codsaday waddan kale oo Dublin ah (EU, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein iyo Switzerland) ama
• horay uga helay sharciga degenaanshada.
Haddii gobol kale oo Dublin ah uu oggolaaday ama aan laga hor istaagin sharci (fiise) ama soo gelid sharci-darro ah (xudduudda badda ama cagaarka).
entity1.id3.entry3.title: Joog
entity1.id3.entry3.subtitle:
Inta lagu jiro nidaamka ogolaanshaha, waxaa laguu ogol yahay oo kaliya inaad joogto degmada xarunta daryeelka kala duwan.
Xaddidaadda aagga ay ka tirsan tahay waxay ku qoran tahay khariidadda geeddi-socodka cagaaran.
entity1.id3.entry4.title: Wareysi ka dhacay Xafiiska Federaalka ee Socdaalka iyo Magangalyada (BFA):
entity1.id3.entry4.subtitle:
Wareysigani waa su'aalo dhowr saacadood qaadanaya.
•Magangelyo-doonka waxaa la waydiiyaa xaaladahooda gaarka ah, socdaalkooda Awstaria iyo sababaha ay u duuleen.
Wareysigan, waxaa muhiim ah in laga dhigo "cabsida saxda ah ee cadaadiska" (Qod. 1 GRC).
• Wareysiga waxaa lagu qaadi doonaa luqad la fahmi karo waxaana turjumi doona tarjumaan.
•Magangelyo-doonku waxa ay wehelin karaan wakiil sharci.Qofka aad ku kalsoon tahay isna wuu iman karaa, laakiin waa inuu iska aamusaa.
• Qoraalka wareysiga dib ayaa loo turjumi doonaa dhamaadka.Waa muhiim in la saxo weedhaha aan si sax ah loo diiwaan gelin.

entity3.id6.entry2.subtitle: Carruurta da'doodu u dhaxayso 5-6 sano waa inay dhammaystiraan sannad-dugsiyeedka khasabka ah ee xannaanada.
entity3.id6.entry3.title: Cawaaqibta sharciga
entity3.id6.entry3.subtitle: Haddii aad ku xad gudubto shuruudaha dugsigaaga ama xanaanada, waxaa jira cawaaqib sharci iyo ganaaxyo.
entity3.id6.entry4.title: jarmalka baro
entity3.id6.entry4.subtitle: Jarmalku wuxuu muhiim u yahay nolol maalmeedka, shaqada iyo xafiisyada.Ka faa'iidayso fursadaha waxbarasho ee bilaashka ah.
entity3.id7.title: Shaqada iyo shaqada
entity3.id7.subtitle: Xeerarka bilowga shaqada
entity3.id7.entry1.title: Ogolaanshaha shaqada
entity3.id7.entry1.subtitle: Shaqada caadiga ah waxaad u baahan tahay ogolaansho shaqo.AMS waxay baartaa suuqa shaqada.
entity3.id7.entry2.title: Hawlaha guriga
entity3.id7.entry2.subtitle: Magangalyo doonka 3 bilood ka dib waxaa loo ogolyahay inay ka shaqeeyaan guryo gaar ah (service check).
entity3.id7.entry3.title: Kaaliyaha shaqada
entity3.id7.entry3.subtitle: Magangalyo doonka la ansixiyay waxay qaban karaan shaqo aan xirfad lahayn oo ah hoy ama shaqo samafal.
entity3.id7.entry4.title: Imtixaanka suuqa shaqada
entity3.id7.entry4.subtitle: Kahor ansixinta, AMS waxay hubisaa in shaqaale Awstariya la heli karo iyo in kale.
entity3.id8.title: Waajibaadka warbixinta iyo joogista
entity3.id8.subtitle: Deganaanshaha iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa
entity3.id8.entry1.title: Bedelka ciwaanka
entity3.id8.entry1.subtitle: U soo sheeg isbeddel kasta oo ku yimaadda ciwaankaada maamulka diiwaangelinta 3 maalmood gudahood.
entity3.id8.entry2.title: Isbeddelka dawladnimada
entity3.id8.entry2.subtitle: Laguuma ogola inaad u guurto deegaankaaga gobol kale oo federaal ah fasax la'aan.
entity3.id8.entry3.title: Ka tag Austria
entity3.id8.entry3.subtitle: Haddii aad ka tagto Awstaria, nidaamkaaga magangelyo waa la joojin doonaa!
entity3.id8.entry4.title: Maamulka diiwaangelinta
entity3.id8.entry4.subtitle: Awstaria, way ku filan tahay inaad iska diiwaan geliso maamulka diiwaangelinta saddex maalmood gudahood.
entity4.id1.title: Go'aan wanaagsan - aqoonsiga magangalyada
entity4.id1.subtitle: Maxay ka dhigan tahay in loo aqoonsado qof xaq u leh magangelyo?
entity4.id1.entry1.title: Ogolaanshaha deganaanshaha
entity4.id1.entry1.subtitle: Waxaad heli doontaa sharci degenaansho 3 sano ah sida qof xaq u leh magangalyo.Tani waa la kordhin karaa 3 sano ka dib haddii shuruudaha ay weli jiraan.
entity4.id1.entry2.title: Gaarsiinta shakhsi ahaaneed
entity4.id1.entry2.subtitle: Go'aanka togan waxa lagugu soo gudbin doonaa shakhsi ahaan ama warqad diiwaan gashan.Si taxadar leh u hubi dhammaan macluumaadka.
entity4.id1.entry3.title: Dukumeentiga safarka
entity4.id1.entry3.subtitle: Kuwa xaqa u leh magangalyada waxay codsan karaan dukumeenti socdaal oo loogu talagalay qaxootiga.Tani waxay sahlaysa in loo safro wadamo badan (marka laga reebo wadanka asal ahaan).
entity4.id1.entry4.title: Xuquuqda degdega ah
entity4.id1.entry4.subtitle: Go'aanka togan waxaad isla markiiba heli doontaa: si aan xadidnayn oo suuqa shaqada loo galo, xaqa gunnada qoyska iyo xuquuq bulsho oo buuxda.
entity4.id2.title: Tallaabooyinka ugu horreeya aqoonsiga ka dib
entity4.id2.subtitle: Maxaa la gudboon in aad samayso go'aan wanaagsan ka dib?
entity4.id2.entry1.title: Codso xaqiijinta diiwaangelinta
entity4.id2.entry1.subtitle: Ka codso maamulka diiwangelinta xaqiijinta diiwaan gelinta oo leh xaaladdaada cusub 2 toddobaad gudahood.
entity4.id2.entry2.title: badbaadada bulshada
entity4.id2.entry2.subtitle: Iska diiwaan geli caymiska bulshada (ÖGK).Waxaad heli doontaa kaarka elektaroonigga ah ee adeegyada caafimaadka.
entity4.id2.entry3.title: Suuqa shaqada
entity4.id2.entry3.subtitle: Uma baahnid ogolaansho shaqo.Waxaad qaadan kartaa shaqo kasta oo sharci ah.Iska diiwaan geli AMS si aad gargaar u hesho.
entity4.id2.entry4.title: Jooji daryeelka aasaasiga ah
entity4.id2.entry4.subtitle: U sheeg xaruntaada daryeelka go'aanka togan.Daryeelka aasaasiga ahi wuxuu dhammaanayaa 4 toddobaad kadib helitaanka ogeysiiska.
entity4.id3.title: Koorsooyinka isdhexgalka & luqadda
entity4.id3.subtitle: Waajibaadka iyo soo jeedinta aqoonsiga kadib
entity4.id3.entry1.title: heshiiska isdhexgalka
entity4.id3.entry1.subtitle: Waa inaad ku muujisaa xirfadaha luqadda Jarmalka heerka A2 2 sano gudahood oo aad dhammaystirto qiyamka iyo koorsada hanuuninta.
entity4.id3.entry2.title: Koorsooyinka Jarmalka (ÖIF)
entity4.id3.entry2.subtitle: Koorsooyin Jarmal ah oo bilaash ah oo laga helo Sanduuqa Isdhexgalka Australiya.Koorsooyinka A1 iyo A2 waa qasab in lagu kordhiyo sharcigaaga joogitaanka.
entity4.id3.entry3.title: Qiimaha iyo koorsada hanuuninta
entity4.id3.entry3.subtitle: Koorso qasab ah oo ku saabsan qiyamka Austria, taariikhda iyo ku dhaqanka sharciga.Muddada: 8 saacadood, bilaash ah ÖIF.
entity4.id3.entry4.title: U fiirso waqtiyada kama dambaysta ah
entity4.id3.entry4.subtitle: Heshiiska isdhexgalka waa in lagu fuliyaa 2 sano gudahood.Haddii kale, kordhinta ogolaanshaha joogitaanka waa la diidi karaa.
entity4.id4.title: Midaynta qoyska
entity4.id4.subtitle: Keen qoyska Awstariya
entity4.id4.entry1.title: Dadka idman
entity4.id4.entry1.subtitle: Lammaanaha, lammaanaha diiwaangashan iyo carruurta aan qaan-gaarin waa la soo kaxaysan karaa.Waalidiinta iyo qaraabada kale kaliya xaaladaha adag.
entity4.id4.entry2.title: Wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah
entity4.id4.entry2.subtitle: Ku soo gudbi codsi 12 bilood gudahooda ee aqoonsiga magangalyada.Intaa ka dib, shuruudo adag ayaa lagu dabaqaa.
entity4.id4.entry3.title: Shuruudaha
entity4.id4.entry3.subtitle: Meel ku filan oo lagu noolaado, hab-nololeed sugan, caymis caafimaad dhammaan xubnaha qoyska.
entity4.id4.entry4.title: Talaabada
entity4.id4.entry4.subtitle: U gudbi codsi qunsuliyada Austria ee wadankii asalka ahaa.Muddada habka: 6-12 bilood.
entity4.id5.title: Go'aan diidmo - diidmo
entity4.id5.subtitle: Maxay ka dhigan tahay diidmada codsiga magangalyada?
entity4.id5.entry1.title: Hubi wargelinta
entity4.id5.entry1.subtitle: Si taxaddar leh u hubi go'aanka: sababaha diidmada, macluumaadka ku saabsan siyaabaha sharciga ah iyo waqtiyada kama dambaysta ah.La taliyaha sharciga ha kuu sharaxo.
entity4.id5.entry2.title: Xilliga kama dambaysta ah ee racfaanka
entity4.id5.entry2.subtitle: Waxaad haysataa 4 toddobaad laga bilaabo bixinta go'aanka si aad ashtako ugu gudbiso Maxkamadda Maamulka Federaalka.
entity4.id5.entry3.title: Joog wakhtiga cabashada
entity4.id5.entry3.subtitle: Waxaa laguu oggol yahay inaad joogtid Awstaria inta lagu jiro xilliga cabashada iyo habka cabashada (saamaynta joojinta).
entity4.id5.entry4.title: Dib u celinta Dublin
entity4.id5.entry4.subtitle: Haddii Dublin la diido: Austria mas'uul kama aha.Waxaa lagu celin doonaa dalka ka masuulka ah Midowga Yurub.kama dambaysta ah: 6 bilood
entity4.id6.title: Habka Cabashooyinka
entity4.id6.subtitle: Sideed u gudbisaa cabasho?
entity4.id6.entry1.title: Shuruudaha rasmiga ah
entity4.id6.entry1.subtitle: Cabashooyinka waa in qoraal ahaan loogu gudbiyaa hay'adda soo saartay go'aanka (BFA).Xaq-siinta ayaa loo baahan yahay.
entity4.id6.entry2.title: Talo sharci oo bilaash ah
entity4.id6.entry2.subtitle: La-taliye sharci ayaa diyaar u ah inuu kaa caawiyo cabashadaada lacag la'aan.La xidhiidh BBU, Caritas ama Diakonie.
entity4.id6.entry3.title: Cadaymo cusub
entity4.id6.entry3.subtitle: Cadaymo cusub ayaa laga yaabaa in lagu soo bandhigo habka rafcaanka ee aan la heli karin dacwadii hore.
entity4.id6.entry4.title: Muddada habraaca
entity4.id6.entry4.subtitle: Habka cabashadu waxay qaadataa celcelis ahaan 6-12 bilood.Xaaladaha degdega ah, codsi degdeg ah ayaa la soo gudbin karaa.
entity4.id7.title: Ilaalinta hoose
entity4.id7.subtitle: Beddelka haddii magangalyada la diido
entity4.id7.entry1.title: Shuruudaha
entity4.id7.entry1.subtitle: Ilaalinta hoose waxaa la bixiyaa marka ay jirto khatar dhibaato halis ah: ciqaab dil, jirdil, si xun ula dhaqmo ama hanjabaad shakhsiyeed oo halis ah oo iskahorimaad hubeysan.
entity4.id7.entry2.title: xaq
entity4.id7.entry2.subtitle: Ogolaanshiyaha joogitaanka 1-sano (la dheerayn karo), ogolaanshaha shaqada, helitaanka manfacyada bulshada, laakiin mideynta qoyska oo kooban.
entity4.id7.entry3.title: Hubinta tooska ah
entity4.id7.entry3.subtitle: BFA waxay si toos ah u hubisaa ilaalinta hoose haddii magangelyo la diido.Uma baahnid inaad soo gudbiso codsi gooni ah.
entity4.id7.entry4.title: Talaabada
entity4.id7.entry4.subtitle: Haddii ilaalinta hoose la bixiyo, waxaad heli doontaa go'aan gaar ah.Waxa kale oo jirta in aad xaq u leedahay in aad cabasho soo gudbiso.
entity4.id8.title: Masaafurinta iyo soo noqoshada
entity4.id8.subtitle: Maxaa dhacaya haddii ugu dambeyntii la i diido?
entity4.id8.entry1.title: kama dambaysta bixida
entity4.id8.entry1.subtitle: Diidmada kama dambaysta ah ka dib: 1 bilood oo lagaga bixi karo dalka.Haddii aad si ikhtiyaari ah uga baxdo dalka: taageerada barnaamijka REAG/GARP.
entity4.id8.entry2.title: Talo soo celi
entity4.id8.entry3.title: Soo noqoshada ikhtiyaarka ah
entity4.id8.entry3.subtitle: Soo noqoshada ikhtiyaarka ah waxaa lagu taageeraa dhaqaale ahaan: tigidhada duulimaadka, lacagta safarka (ilaa € 1000), kaalmada dib-u-dhexgalka ee waddankii hooyo.
entity4.id8.entry4.title: Xarig qasab ah & masaafurinta
entity4.id9.title: Xuquuqda bini'aadantinimo ee joogista
entity4.id9.subtitle: Waxa ka reebban haddii ay dhacdo caqabado ku wajahan masaafurinta
entity4.id9.entry1.title: Jiro
entity4.id9.entry2.title: Nolosha qoyska
entity4.id9.entry2.subtitle: Xidhiidh dhow oo lala yeesho xubnaha qoyska ee ku nool Awsteriya (gaar ahaan carruurta) waxay marmarsiinyo u noqon kartaa xaqa joogitaanka.
entity4.id9.entry3.title: is dhexgalka
entity4.id9.entry3.subtitle: Ka dib joogitaan dheer (dhowr sano) iyo is dhexgalka wanaagsan, xuquuqda joogista waxaa la siin karaa sababo bini'aadantinimo.
entity4.id9.entry4.title: Codsiga
entity4.id9.entry4.subtitle: Xuquuqda bini'aadantinimo ee joogitaanka waa in si gaar ah looga codsadaa BFA.Heerka guushu waa yar yahay, talada sharci waa lama huraan.
entity4.id10.title: Cinwaanada iyo caawinta muhiimka ah
entity4.id10.subtitle: Yaa caawin kara?
entity4.id10.entry1.title: Talo sharci
entity4.id10.entry1.subtitle: BBU, Caritas, Diakonie, Asylkoordination waxay bixiyaan talo sharci oo bilaash ah cabashooyinka iyo talaabooyinka dheeraadka ah.
entity4.id10.entry2.title: Soo celi kaalmada
entity4.id10.entry2.subtitle: IOM (Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Socdaalka): +43 1 585 33 22, info@iom.int - Talo iyo taageero dib u noqoshada.
entity4.id10.entry3.title: Caawinta isdhexgalka
entity4.id10.entry3.subtitle: Sanduuqa Isdhexgalka Australiya (ÖIF): Koorsooyin Jarmal ah, talobixin, koorsooyin hanuunin ah oo loogu talagalay qaxootiga la aqoonsan yahay.
entity4.id10.entry4.title: Caawinta nafsiga ah ee bulshada
entity4.id10.entry4.subtitle: teraabiyada cilminafsiga iyo la-talinta cilmi nafsiga ee jahawareerka ama walbahaarka nafsiga ah ee ay sababto habsocodku.
entity4.id8.entry2.subtitle: Talo bilaash ah oo ka socota IOM ama Caritas oo ku saabsan xulashooyinka soo noqoshada, taageerada maaliyadeed iyo dib-u-dhexgalka.
entity4.id8.entry4.subtitle: Haddii ay dhacdo bixitaan aan ikhtiyaari ahayn: haynta sugitaanka masaafurinta (ugu badnaan 10 bilood) waa suurtagal, oo ay ku xigto masaafurinta iyada oo ay weheliso booliisku.
entity4.id9.entry1.subtitle: Jirrada halista ah ee aan lagu daweyn karin gudaha dalka ayaa marmarsiinyo u noqon karta xuquuqda bini'aadantinimo ee lagu joogo.
